mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, real_name, gender, birthday, phone, email, school, college, major, grade, location, bio, created_at, updated_at FROM user_profile_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile_detail( user_id, real_name, gender, birthday, phone, email, school, college, major, grade, location, bio, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{entity.userId}, #{entity.realName}, #{entity.gender}, #{entity.birthday}, #{entity.phone}, #{entity.email}, #{entity.school}, #{entity.college}, #{entity.major}, #{entity.grade}, #{entity.location}, #{entity.bio}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile_detail SET real_name = #{entity.realName}, gender = #{entity.gender}, birthday = #{entity.birthday}, phone = #{entity.phone}, email = #{entity.email}, school = #{entity.school}, college = #{entity.college}, major = #{entity.major}, grade = #{entity.grade}, location = #{entity.location}, bio = #{entity.bio}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{entity.userId}
